question:
Select the option that rectifies the underlined spelling error.

The students had to write an essay for their __asignment__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"asignment"** is a misspelling of the word "assignment".
 
• **​"Assignment" **refers to a task or piece of work allocated to someone as part of a job or course of study. (असाइनमेंट)
 
 
• **Example: **The students had to complete their **assignment **
